About Chadele Nigeria

Get To Know Our Experienced HR Consulting Team

Headquartered in Lagos with strategic presence in Abuja, Chadele provides comprehensive human capital solutions across Nigeria and West Africa. We blend international SHRM/SPHR methodologies with deep statutory mastery of the Nigerian Labour Act, PenCom, and state tax systems.

  • CIPM & Senior SPHR Certified Partners
    All engagements are guided by Chartered Institute of Personnel Management (CIPM) accredited leaders with 15+ years of frontline corporate advisory experience.
  • 100% Nigerian Statutory & Labour Act Compliance
    Complete audit protection for Pension Reform Act (PRA 2014), PAYE/LIRS remittances, NSITF, NHF, and Industrial Training Fund (ITF) statutory mandates.
  • Japa-Proof Retention & FX Compensation Design
    Bespoke inflation-hedging compensation bands, dual-currency incentives, and high-engagement culture structures designed to defend key talent.

Nigerian Compliance & FAQ

Answers To Top Client Questions

Everything you need to know about working with Chadele HR Advisory in Nigeria.

We conduct a comprehensive review of your employment contracts, redundancy clauses, disciplinary protocols, and working hours against the Nigerian Labour Act (2004) and National Industrial Court of Nigeria (NICN) rulings to ensure zero legal liability.
We audit your payroll to ensure 100% accurate calculation and remittance under the Pension Reform Act (8% employee, 10% employer), NSITF (1% of payroll), Industrial Training Fund (1% for 5+ employees), and National Housing Fund (2.5% of basic salary).
We combine three proven levers: (1) FX-hedged or inflation-adjusted compensation buffers, (2) Accelerated career advancement paths with rapid seniority milestone reviews, and (3) Active internal knowledge redundancy frameworks so departures do not stall operations.
Yes. Our senior partners operate out of Victoria Island, Lagos and Maitama, Abuja. We provide both fractional embedded on-site leadership and executive board advisory whenever needed.
